title: Navigating the Archive & Global Search
style: Warm, clear archival museum narrator at a calm, unhurried pace.

steps.title: Switch across primary archival views
steps.posterAlt: Lincoln and Todd demo archive top bar highlighting People, Places, Evidence, Time, Tree, and Map links.

cues.text: The top navigation bar organizes the Lincoln and Todd demo archive into core axes: People, Places, Evidence and Sources, Time, Family Tree, and Migration Map.
You can switch views at any time without losing your place, or open the Reading Room to inspect primary record transcriptions.

steps.title: Find any record with Global Search
steps.posterAlt: Global Search modal open over the Lincoln and Todd archive ready to search people, places, events, and source pages.

cues.text: Press the slash key or Command K anywhere in Kinloom to open Global Search.
Type a surname such as Lincoln or Todd, a town like Springfield, or a historical year to jump directly to matching records.
